Hi Sandra,

Thanks for sending these over 9999attachments look good as a start. To complete vendor master creation on our side we need a couple of structured items so Finance can open a payee record and route the first PO: 

1) Completed Redwood Supplier Intake form (we use it to capture remittance address and contact roles)
2) Confirm legal entity exactly as you want it to appear on the PO and payments file (you listed BlueBeam Technologies, Inc. which should be fine, but confirm if you want the 'DBA' field populated)
3) Remittance address (if different from the office address you sent)
4) A point of contact for invoicing (name, email, phone)
5) Bank letter is perfect 9999we just need it on letterhead (yours is fine)

I’ve uploaded our supplier intake template here: https://drive.google.com/REDWOOD/supplier-intake/bluebeam-2026 and attached a blank copy for convenience (Redwood_Supplier_Intake.xlsx). If you can return the populated file and re-attach the W-9 via DocuSign (preferred), we’ll expedite the vendor setup.

Once Finance confirms the payee record we will create a supplier ID and confirm PO routing and payment terms. Typical turnaround is 3-5 business days after we receive the completed intake.

Next steps: can you fill the intake and send back by EOD Tuesday? If you need longer, please propose a date.

Appreciate it,
